Три «падения» — предсуществующие: эти файлы написаны под `node:test` (их проверки проходят: pass 2), а vitest не находит в них suite; `save-manager.test.mjs` дополнительно требует каталог `.test-build`. К курсам отношения не имеют. Публикую изменения.

```json
{"version":1,"taskId":"6629a04b-04c6-461d-8a8b-4c8c98e07034","commandId":"pub-1","operation":"publish","headSha":"39e05ff6bd2ffe0fb005bb3ce122a544423e3034","message":"feat(courses): add hole-level builder API and port Green Hills to it\n\nHoleBuilder implements the level API from the design doc (addFloor, addWall,\naddRamp, addCurve, addHole, addObstacle, addSpinner, addMovingPlatform,\naddTeleporter, addFan, addConveyor, addBumper, addWater, addKillZone) on top of\nthe existing surface/obstacle descriptors, and returns either a plain validated\nHole or a blueprint carrying runtime zones and force-obstacle configs.\nCourseBuilder gains addHoleWith(), green-hills is authored through the builder,\nand builder.test.ts covers the new API."}
```
